name: aeonos
description: Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) agent. Call AEONOS to make any website citable by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews. Persistent memory per caller_id — no re-sending context on repeat calls.

authentication.description: Base wallet private key (0x...) with USDC on Base for x402 payments, passed as X-Wallet-Key header

tools.name: aeonos_query
tools.description: Ask AEONOS any AEO/GEO question. Get citation tactics, quick wins, keyword strategy, or AI visibility advice for any website. Returns structured Markdown. 0.05 USDC per call.

tools.name: aeonos_audit
tools.description: Full AEO/GEO audit. Returns AI readiness score (0–100), four-layer analysis, and P1/P2/P3 action roadmap. 2.50 USDC per call.

tools.name: aeonos_schema
tools.description: Generate production-ready JSON-LD Schema.org markup (FAQPage, Product, Service, LocalBusiness, HowTo). Returns valid JSON-LD ready for <head> injection. 0.50 USDC per call.

tools.name: aeonos_llms_txt
tools.description: Generate a complete llms.txt file for any website. Structured for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude crawlers. 0.50 USDC per call.

tools.name: aeonos_progress
tools.description: Score a website on the AEO Four Layers framework (SXO/AIO/GEO/AEO). Returns per-layer scores and next 3 actions. 1.50 USDC per call.
